description: Runs from gear-ops/IaC's .github/workflows/renovate.yaml. Actions are pinned by commit and the images a step runs with docker by digest. Updates are grouped into one PR a week and nothing merges by itself.

customManagers.description: An image a step runs with docker: <NAME>_IMAGE: <image>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>

packageRules.description: An action or an image follows a release a week after it came out: a hijacked tag is usually found within days
A digest that changes under an unchanged version means the tag was moved: it waits for its checkbox in the Dependency Dashboard
Majors wait for their checkbox in the Dependency Dashboard
